_comment: The shared currency vocabulary. The rule these protect is that a verdict is never favourable on absent evidence - an offline board or an unreadable record must not read as up to date, because the cost is a screen or a toolhead left running old firmware while the panel says it is current.

mutations.name: an offline device is never reported as up to date
a device we cannot read a version from is not up to date
a dirty build is unprovable, not proven current
a board sitting in its bootloader wants firmware
an artifact with no provenance cannot claim to be current
an image built from a dirty tree cannot claim to be current
a reason nobody defined is refused rather than carried

mutations.name: an image we cannot vouch for is never painted green
a device whose version we cannot read is never painted green
a release match nothing backs is never painted green
a stale image is never painted green
an offline board is a problem, not a caveat
a board waiting in its bootloader is a problem, not a pending update
a pending update is a deviation, not a problem
a built image is never a problem
a tone is chosen per reason, not read off the flash verdict
